new_statements.quote: Most notably, tone is not directly transcribed. This is because the tonal system of at least one variety of Bumthang (Ura) is very complex, involving more than eight contrasts which are susceptible to change due to intonation and the presence of tonally-signalled morphology, and so not amenable to annotation in a survey context. As far as it makes sense to speak of stress in a language with contrastive tone, stress is initial, and trochaic.

new_statements.rule_in_words: In the Bumthang varieties surveyed (including the Trongsa = Nupbikha wordlist), insofar as stress can be identified alongside contrastive tone, it falls on the word-initial syllable with a trochaic pattern.
new_statements.secondary_stress: Nothing stated beyond 'trochaic' (which implies alternating strong-weak feet from the left; no explicit secondary-stress claim).
new_statements.exceptions: None. Statement is hedged ('as far as it makes sense to speak of stress in a language with contrastive tone').
new_statements.domain_note: Survey-level transcription note applying to elicited wordlist items (citation forms) across seven varieties; Bumthang has high/low register tone (van Driem 2015:23-24) and Ura reportedly many more surface pitch contrasts (Donohue 2020 fn. 8). Not a Trongsa-specific claim.
new_statements.identity_note: nupb1238 is a Glottolog Bookkeeping languoid (Ethnologue-spurious): 'Nupbikha denotes no more than "language of the west" and the variety spoken there is linguistically a variety of Bumthang [kjz]' (Glottolog comment citing van Driem 2001:908). van Driem 2015:20 identifies it as the Trongsa dialect of Bumthang ('Trongsabi kha... also sometimes called Nupbi kha'), intermediate between Bumthang and Kheng; he adds that the same name is also used for the Hâ dialect of Dzongkha. The quoted stress statement is from a survey of Bumthang varieties (bumt1240) whose wordlists include Trongsa; it is not specific to the Trongsa variety. Recommend folding this key into bumt1240 rather than cataloguing it as a distinct entity.
